chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabr, who said:

A man came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said, 'I am a young, active man and I love Jihad, and I have a mother who dislikes that.' So the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to him, 'Return and be with your mother, for by the One who sent me with the Truth as a Prophet, your comforting her for one night is better than your Jihad in the Way of Allah for a year.'

key_terms.جِهَاد: Striving or exertion in the path of God, often referring to military struggle but also spiritual effort

ai.seo_question: Is serving one's mother better than Jihad?
ai.summary: In this well-known narration from *Al-Kafi*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his progeny) elevates filial piety to a status equal to or surpassing the highly revered act of Jihad, specifically addressing a young man eager for military struggle. The comparison of one night of comforting a mother to a year of Jihad underscores the immense weight of parental satisfaction in Shia jurisprudence, particularly when parents are reluctant or elderly, establishing it as a primary duty that can supersede other voluntary acts of worship.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman, from Amro Bin Shimr, from Jabir who said,

‘A man came over to Rasool-Allahsaww and he said, ‘I am a man who is an active youth, and I love the Jihād, and for me is a mother who dislikes that’. So the Prophetsaww said to him: ‘Return, and be with your mother, for by the Oneazwj Who Sent mesaww with the Truth as a Prophetsaww, Your comforting her for one night is better than your Jihād in the Way of Allahazwj for a year’.
en.sarwar: 20. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus ibn ‘Abd al- Rahman from ‘ Amr ibn Shamir from Jabir who has said the following:

“Once a man came to the Messenger of Allah and said, ‘I am a young and active man and love Jihad (joining the army), but my mother does not like it.’ The Holy Prophet said, ‘Go back and stay with your mother. I swear by the One Who has sent me with the truth as a prophet that her feeling comfort because of your presence for one night is better for your Jihad in the way of Allah for one year.”
